title: A split work order's log entry shows Unassigned for an empty side
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and "Sales Representative - Labor" set to sales rep A and "Sales Representative - Parts" set to sales rep B.
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Set "Sales Representative - Labor" to "Unassigned".
  2. Open the work order's menu.
  3. Click Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Labor reads "Unassigned".

Step 2:

  • The work order's menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The newest entry reads "Sales Representative: [sales rep B's name] (Parts) · [sales rep A's name] (Labor) → [sales rep B's name] (Parts) · Unassigned (Labor)".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11271 (Story 7, Record representative changes in the work order log)

  • S7-R3: “A split work order reads both sides, Parts first: "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Elliot Brennan (Labor)". An empty side reads "Unassigned", for example "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Unassigned (Labor)".”
  • S7-R1: “Each change to a work order's representatives, including adding or removing the Parts field, writes one log entry, "Sales representative changed". Adding the Parts field with the same person on both sides is a change and writes one entry, for example "Sales Representative: Ann Able → Ann Able (Parts) · Ann Able (Labor)".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 1, board 1.19 "The log records every rep change", export read 19 Oct 2026.
